newsitem.title: USA: Intel files suit against Cyrix, AMD.
newsitem.headline: Intel files suit against Cyrix, AMD.

text.p: Intel Corp on Friday said it filed a lawsuit against Advanced Micro Devices Inc and Cyrix Corp in U.S. District Court in Delaware for infringement of Intel's "MMX" trademark.
MMX is Intel's media enhancement technology.

In a statement, the company alleged AMD and Cyrix have designed and begun implementing strategies to improperly leverage Intel's investment in the MMX trademark which could result in confusion in the minds of consumers as they make buying decisions.
The suit seeks preliminary and permanent injunctive relief along with unspecified damages and fees.
